content: A AREBBI, war sseɣd, war ttegg Ixef nnec d adehcur, war seqqar ca, a Arebbi.
Maɣar xzar, řɛedyan nnec ttarruǧuden, inni Cek icarrhen ssgeɛɛden azeǧif.
Ttxarrṣen deg ict n tmeɛmuč di tnuffar ḍidd i řgens nnec, ttemcawaren x yinni ittwaḥḍan zzayek.
Qqaren: “Asem-dd, ejj aneɣ ad ten nteḥḥa am řgens, ařami war ittidar ɛad deg yisem n Israil.”
Maɣar ttemcawaren s wuř d ijj, aqa tteggen ijj n řɛahd ḍidd i Cek:
iqiḍan n Idum d ayt n Ismaɛil, Mu’ab d ayt n Hajar,
Jabal d Ɛammun d Ɛamaliq, Filicit d imezdaɣ n Ṣur.
Uřa d Accur immarni ɣarsen. Nitni tuɣa aten d afus ijhed i ayt n Luṭ. Silah.
Egg asen am Midyan d Sisara, am Yabin ɣar yeɣzar n Qicun.
Nitni ttwateḥḥan ɣar Ɛayn-Dur, dewřen d řeɣbar x temmurt.
Egg i-ten ak-d tarwa n taṣiřet nsen am Ɣurab d Di’b, marra ayt n jjehd nsen am Zabaḥ d Ṣalmunnaɛ,
inni iqqaren: “Ejj aneɣ ad neṭṭef tizeddiɣin n AREBBI i yixef nneɣ d řwart.”
A AREBBI inu, egg i-ten am yijj n uqellij ittennḍen di řeɛwin, am uřum zzat i wudem n usemmiḍ.
Am tmessi tessreqqa azɣar, am uceɛɛař ittett idurar,
aẓẓeř ammu xasen s usemmiḍ nnec, snexřeɛ i-ten s tḥaryaḍt nnec.
Řeḥḥef udem nsen s řeḥya, maḥend nitni, a SIDI, ad arzun x Yisem nnec.
Ejj i-ten ad barrqen u ad arejfen i řebda, ejj i-ten ad seḍḥan uca ad ttwahellken,
ḥima ad ssnen, aqa Cek waha i ɣar iǧa Yisem ‘SIDI’, Amɛuǧi x marra tammurt.
